# Test rejection of pkg@version in BOLERO_PATH mode.
env BOLERO_MODULE=off
! bolero get rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^bolero: modules disabled by BOLERO_MODULE=off'
! bolero build rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^package rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1: can only use path@version syntax with ''bolero get'' and ''bolero install'' in module-aware mode$'

env BOLERO_MODULE=on
cd x
! bolero build rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1
stderr '^package rsc.io/quote@v1.5.1: can only use path@version syntax with ''bolero get'' and ''bolero install'' in module-aware mode$'

-- x/go.mod --
module x
